problems: Cliopatria's United States of America 1967..2005 shape contains 551 cells (139,348 km2) of southern Vietnam (the Republic of Vietnam's 1966 land, then the Socialist Republic's south); no page records a US occupation. Fix belongs to am-07; it probably explains the missing Republic of Vietnam shape for 1967-1972.
Cliopatria's French Indochina 1956..1957 shape (35,422 km2) lies at 55-168 E, 20-50 S in the gazetteer, not in Indochina (se-03).

Cliopatria's Malaysia keeps Singapore through 1966 (it left on 9 August 1965; its own row starts in 1967) and lacks two border cells (506 km2) at Limbang before 1987; Cliopatria's Federation of Malaya and Republic of Vietnam, Khmer Rouge, Communist Laos and Republic of Singapore rows all start one or two years after the state (new keyframes added).
Shared Wikidata ids resolved: Q172640 (republic-of-vietnam vs democratic-republic-of-vietnam) and Q1479726 (federation-of-malaya vs malaya 1294-1351) are different states, no merge.

The Malaysia dossier opened six pages against a budget of five (two shared with other dossiers, one thin: Limbang Division). The Singapore dossier cites a third page (Indonesia-Malaysia confrontation) for its war entry only.

Pages were read through WebFetch's extraction model, not as raw text; every quoted sentence is the extraction's, each under 125 characters, and the extraction sometimes reported its own gaps (Laos page has no post-1975 border event; PRG page gives no zones; Malaysia page lacks the 2002 and 2008 rulings).
Island regions (Paracels, Phu Quoc area circle excepted, Pedra Branca, Sipadan) resolve to no land cells, so those events are records, not drawn changes.
